externalPending.message: Periphery 3.7.4 is pinned and report-only, but the binary is not installed on PATH for the calibration scan.

notes: Initial bootstrap report. Full cleanup campaign still required before goal completion.
Use scripts/code-hygiene-audit.mjs for report-only TODO, duplicate asset, and unreferenced asset candidate findings.
Use scripts/code-hygiene-periphery.mjs for report-only Swift package calibration once the pinned binary is available.
Initial ClawJS dependency cleanup removed chokidar from sessions and @noble/hashes from profile.
Knip entrypoint calibration now includes tool configs, local scripts, seed files, and public JS assets.
ClawJS built-in family barrel findings plus two reviewed dynamic-runtime findings are covered by expiring baseline entries.
Root dependency normalization moved VitePress/Vue ownership to website, declared direct root tsx usage, and calibrated the Vitest coverage provider dependency.

Knip workspace calibration now maps top-level app/module workspaces to their own package manifests with explicit entry/project shapes, drops reviewed direct app/database dependencies now provided by actual imports, and baselines two reviewed dynamic runtime findings.

Workspace dependency cleanup removed reviewed unused direct dependencies from top-level app/module package manifests, updated their package locks, expanded report-only Knip entry ownership for memory/modules service entrypoints, and reduced dependency/devDependency findings to zero.
Discord test catalog cleanup made file-local operation field constants private while preserving the test helpers imported across Discord request/executor tests.
Secrets crypto cleanup made module-private constants and helper functions private while preserving the server crypto API used by stores, resolver, app, scripts, and smoke tests.
Knip calibration now treats templates, public CSS, website CSS/HTML, generated fixtures, and reviewed cross-repo e2e imports as report-only owned surfaces.
Unused file cleanup removed reviewed legacy CLI sidecar command files, private server re-export wrappers, placeholder clients, and unreferenced configs; Knip file findings are now zero.
Dead-file cleanup removed reviewed one-line server stubs, retired CLI bin shims, stale generated configs, and unreferenced helper modules while keeping package surface bins explicitly allowlisted.
Database store-helper cleanup made clearly internal parser, normalizer, regex, and constraint helpers private while keeping the database package contract unchanged.
V1 data core cleanup made session indexing, sidecar schema, TOML rendering, SQL identifier, and text utility helpers private while preserving the v1 data package re-export contract.
Slides cleanup made manifest helper types, layout/theme constants, and local validation helpers private while preserving the `claw slides` command contract.
Database magic and style schema cleanup removed retired productivity alias helpers and made style-only structural types private while preserving CLI style/template behavior.
Agent plan cleanup made local risk/policy evaluation helpers private while keeping the plan CLI and delegation graph test surface unchanged.
Time logic cleanup made local temporal helper aliases and parsing helpers private while keeping exported temporal input/status contracts unchanged.
Execution and Relay protocol cleanup made nested payload/envelope helpers private where only the union or public request/response envelopes are externally consumed.
Secrets shared type cleanup kept exported only the role/principal types imported by auth and made the unused local DTO descriptors private.
Execution shared type cleanup made local status aliases and unused helper DTOs private while preserving imported records and protocol types.
IoT tool registry cleanup made local descriptor and invocation helpers private while keeping server route registration exported.
Publishing schema cleanup made nested Zod schema helpers private and removed unused inferred type aliases while preserving route-imported validators.
Apps store cleanup made local record/input helpers private and removed an unused root-dir helper while preserving `createAppsStore`.
Runtime plugin bridge cleanup made low-level OpenClaw plugin command helpers private while preserving the public bridge facades.
CLI runtime metadata cleanup made actor/guidance helper exports private while preserving the CLI metadata provider entrypoint.
